cases.name: etaf-manual-book-numbers-parts-and-chapters
cases.purpose: Both languages read every chapter in book.json order with part and chapter numbers.

cases.name: etaf-manual-book-translations-share-entries
cases.purpose: Translations list the same chapters and definition entries as English.

cases.name: etaf-manual-definition-finds-entries-by-name-and-kind
cases.purpose: Definition lookup locates an entry by symbol and optional kind in either language.

cases.name: etaf-manual-book-rejects-unknown-language
cases.purpose: A language the book does not provide signals etaf-manual-error.

cases.name: etaf-manual-runnable-examples-mount
cases.purpose: Every runnable example evaluates to a View that mounts without warnings.

cases.name: etaf-manual-example-view-reports-failures
cases.purpose: A failing example signals etaf-manual-error naming the example.

cases.name: etaf-manual-generated-content-covers-the-book
cases.purpose: Every generated appendix and index carries content and links each interface or index term it promises.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-create-reports-state
cases.purpose: A new session reads the first chapter and exposes its outline.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-accepts-a-chapter-name
cases.purpose: A chapter named by its string name opens that chapter, and the same name works for a later jump.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-rejects-an-unknown-chapter
cases.purpose: An unknown chapter signals etaf-manual-error and leaves the reading position unchanged.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-navigation-walks-sections-and-chapters
cases.purpose: Next and previous move through sections and roll into other chapters.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-up-follows-levels
cases.purpose: Up moves a level-3 section to its level-2 parent and then to the top.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-history-walks-both-ways
cases.purpose: Back and forward move through the reading history.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-language-switch-keeps-position
cases.purpose: Switching language keeps the chapter and reads the other translation.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-toggle-theme-switches-palette
cases.purpose: Toggling the theme flips between the dark and light palettes.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-toc-marks-the-current-chapter
cases.purpose: The outline names the parts, chapters and current sections.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-view-renders-chapter-and-example
cases.purpose: The mounted reader shows the article, chrome and a runnable example.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-example-runs-and-stops-in-place
cases.purpose: The run control renders the real View; stop clears it again.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-example-modes-switch
cases.purpose: Source, preview and side-by-side modes switch per example.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-shows-definition-cards
cases.purpose: A chapter with definition entries renders their cards.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-key-help-lists-reader-keys
cases.purpose: The framework key help lists the reader's own keys with their labels.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-page-keys-drive-navigation
cases.purpose: The page Host's :keys dispatch the reader keys in the mounted runtime.

cases.name: etaf-manual-concept-index-groups-terms-by-initial
cases.purpose: The concept index groups terms under symbols and A-Z, filing Han terms by the Pinyin of their first character.

cases.name: etaf-manual-symbol-index-groups-symbols-by-package
cases.purpose: The symbol index opens with the packages in manual order and lists each prefixed symbol under its own package.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-examples-follow-run-blocks
cases.purpose: Only runnable blocks become example viewers, including runnable examples inside definition entries.

cases.name: etaf-manual-lookup-reaches-the-end-of-a-long-chapter
cases.purpose: Looking up the last entry of a long chapter shows its card immediately in the opened reader.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-jump-targets-cover-the-book
cases.purpose: The jump completion lists chapters, sections, definition entries and index terms with targets that resolve.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-search-walks-matching-sections
cases.purpose: Full-text search lands on matching sections and next/previous walk the result list.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-inline-symbols-link-to-definitions
cases.purpose: A code span naming a definition entry carries a definition help echo and RET jumps to its section.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-page-outline-lists-sections
cases.purpose: A wide reader frames the on-this-page column of the current chapter beside the article.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-chapter-cards-open-neighbours
cases.purpose: The end-of-chapter cards open the previous and next chapter.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-remembers-the-reading-position
cases.purpose: A remembered position restores its language, chapter and section, and a malformed file is ignored.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-edits-and-reruns-an-example
cases.purpose: Submitting the in-place example editor reruns the edited draft and w copies it.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-copies-the-section-code
cases.purpose: The w key copies the current section's code to the kill ring.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-resizes-the-side-columns
cases.purpose: The side columns report their widths, clamp the setters and step from the focused divider.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-renders-inline-figures
cases.purpose: An inline figure renders its View in the chapter with a caption and no run controls.

cases.name: etaf-manual-reader-interactive-surfaces-hover
cases.purpose: Clickable navigation rows and rendered links carry a pointer hover face.
